source.author: verg
source.text: Urbs antiqua ruit, multos dominata per annos; plurima perque vias sternuntur inertia passim corpora, perque domos et religiosa deorum limina.
source.text_original: Urbs antiqua ruit, multos dominata per annos; / plurima perque vias sternuntur inertia passim / corpora, perque domos et religiosa deorum / limina.
source.text_english: An ancient city is collapsing, having ruled for many years; everywhere along the streets most lifeless bodies are strewn, and through the houses and the sacred doorways of the gods.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: urbs antiqua ruit multos dominata per annos plurima perque uias sparguntur inertia passim corpora perque domos et plurima mortis imago.
reuse.text_original: urbs antiqua ruit multos dominata per annos plurima perque uias sparguntur inertia passim corpora perque domos et plurima mortis imago.
reuse.text_english: The ancient city falls, having ruled for many years; very many lifeless bodies are scattered everywhere along the streets and through the houses, and everywhere the image of death.
